standard.summary: 限制 torch.compile 因动态形状变化触发重编译的最大次数。超过后退回 eager 模式。
standard.effect: 限制过小 → 频繁形状变化时很快退回 eager；限制过大 → 编译时间长，内存占用高。
standard.whenToUse: 训练使用动态形状（如变长 caption、bucket 训练）时调整。默认值通常足够。
standard.avoidWhen: 固定形状训练（fixed_visual=1）时几乎不会触发重编译，此参数无意义。

standard_en.summary: Caps how many times torch.compile may recompile because of changing dynamic shapes. Past the cap it falls back to eager.
standard_en.effect: Too low a cap falls back to eager quickly when shapes change often; too high a cap means long compilation times and high memory use.
standard_en.whenToUse: Adjust it when training with dynamic shapes (variable-length captions, bucket training). The default is usually enough.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Fixed-shape training (fixed_visual=1) almost never triggers recompilation, so the parameter is moot.

advanced.principle: TorchDynamo 对不同输入形状会触发不同的编译路径（guard 机制）。超过 recompile_limit 后转为不编译（interpret mode）。
advanced.tradeoffs: 提高限制允许更多形状各自获得编译加速，但总编译时间和内存成比例增加。

advanced_en.principle: TorchDynamo takes different compile paths for different input shapes (guard mechanism). Past recompile_limit it stops compiling (interpret mode).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Raising the limit lets more shapes each get compile acceleration, but total compile time and memory grow proportionally.
